name: Sify Technologies
note: Capacity as Sify itself described it, quarter by quarter, on its own earnings calls. The spine is calendar_date, not fiscal_period: the source labels Jan 2024 as FY2023Q3 and Jan 2025 as FY2025Q3, so the fiscal tags are not internally consistent and must not be used for ordering.

source.label: Earnings call pressure points, verbatim management answers to analyst questions

definitions.DESIGN: Design capacity ready for sale. Not built.
definitions.COMMISSIONED: Installed and commissioned, described as live or operational.
definitions.CONTRACTED: Committed to customers who have taken the space.

observations.quote: We presently have 10 data centers spread across 6 cities with capacity, which is in operation of 72 megawatts of IT power.
you mentioned 74 megawatts of capacity at the end of the September quarter
it was, I think, 11 data centers with 100 megawatts of capacity, and you're looking to add another 200 megawatts over the next few years
we crossed more than 100 megawatts IT power already in production, and most of that's already in usage
We have data center operational capacity across 6 cities and 11 facilities of about 100 megawatt.
We currently have data center capacity, which is live and operational for about 120 megawatts, of which 105-megawatt is already being consumed by the customers
we currently have capacity which is installed and commissioned for about 120-megawatt of which 110-megawatt is already contracted with the customers
We have about 188 megawatts of design capacity, which is ready for sale, out of which about 130-megawatt is built.

claims.claim: 100 MW of the announced 200 MW expansion goes live within 18 months
claims.verbatim: out of the 200 meg, which is our overall pan over the next few years, 100 meg will go live in the next 18 months, depending on how the customers -- the pace at which the customers consume the capacity. But we stay committed to increasing our capacity by 200% from where we presently are.
claims.resolved_evidence: On 2024-01-18, three months before the horizon, operational capacity was still described as about 100 MW, unchanged from the level at the time the claim was made.

claims.claim: More than 124 MW of campuses available within 12 months
claims.verbatim: we are building in the next 12 months more than 124 megawatts campuses available in the next 12 months.
claims.resolved_evidence: On 2024-01-18 operational capacity was about 100 MW. By 2024-10-22, six months past the horizon, it was about 120 MW, an increase of roughly 20 MW against more than 124 MW promised.

claims.claim: 400 to 500 MW capacity across the country over four to five years
claims.verbatim: if you're looking at next 4 to 5 years, we are in the road map building 400 to 500 megawatts capacity across the country.

refusals.mechanism_quote: I have a little bit of a constraint. Generally, we don't make forward statements and more importantly, having filed the draft prospectus with the securities regulator I'm prohibited from making any forward statements.
